title: 12 Best Sample kopi luwak-style weasel coffee at a hillside Da Lat coffee farm surrounded by pine forest where civets eat and process the beans.
description: Discover Da Lat's finest weasel coffee farms amidst serene pine forests. Explore where civets naturally process beans for an exquisite coffee experience in Vietnam.
category: Sample kopi luwak-style weasel coffee at a hillside Da Lat coffee farm surrounded by pine

places.name: Mê Linh Coffee Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cup of their signature Weasel Coffee (Cà Phê Chồn) paired with a breathtaking view.

places.name: Trại Hầm Đà Lạt (Dalat Weasel Coffee Farm)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Weasel Coffee (Cà Phê Chồn) to truly appreciate its unique flavor profile.

places.name: K'Ho Coffee Farm
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their ethically sourced Arabica, and if available, their special Weasel Coffee variant.

places.name: Chồn Khải Hoàn (Khai Hoan Weasel Coffee)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A hot cup of their Cà Phê Chồn, and consider buying some beans as a souvenir.

places.name: Cà Phê Chồn Trại Hầm (Branch on Highway 20)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The pure Weasel Coffee for its distinct flavor, or a latte made with it for a softer taste.

places.name: Làng Cà Phê Chồn Việt Nam (Vietnam Weasel Coffee Village)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore different roasts of Weasel Coffee from various producers within the village.

places.name: Hoa Điền Trang (Flower Farm & Cafe)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their special Weasel Coffee, enjoyed amidst the vibrant flower displays.

places.name: Brew & Bloom Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their meticulously brewed Weasel Coffee, presented with artistry.

places.name: Phin Coffee & Bistro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A traditional Phin-filtered Weasel Coffee for a truly Vietnamese taste.

places.name: La Viet Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about their current premium offerings, including any available Weasel Coffee.

places.name: Cà Phê Chồn Quán (Weasel Coffee Shop)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A hot or iced Weasel Coffee, depending on your preference.

places.name: The Married Beans
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order If available, their pour-over Weasel Coffee to fully appreciate its nuances.
